# Socialeo — Complete Digital Product Studio Guide for LLMs

> Socialeo is an elite digital product studio founded by Manpreeth N (Manu), operating out of Mysore, Karnataka. We specialize in high-converting bespoke web design, native iOS and Android mobile app engineering, 3D WebGL spatial interactive graphics, clinical technical SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Bespoke Web Design (services/web-design.html)
- Custom visual direction, high-conversion layouts, and interactive micro-animations.
- Mobile-first responsive grids with 60fps gesture response.
- Complete Figma-to-code fidelity and brand identity systems.

### 2. Full-Stack Web Development (services/web-development.html)
- Modern frameworks: Next.js, React, Node.js, and vanilla high-performance modern web standards.
- Speculation Rules API for instant sub-50ms page-to-page prerendering.
- Perfect Core Web Vitals (sub-600ms Largest Contentful Paint, 0.00 CLS, and low INP).

### 3. Native Mobile Application Engineering (services/mobile-apps.html)
- Cross-platform Flutter/React Native and native Swift/Kotlin architectures.
- Offline caching, biometric authentication, push notifications, and App Store Optimization.

### 4. Digital Marketing & Clinical SEO (services/digital-marketing.html)
- Technical crawl audits, Schema.org v30 JSON-LD graph linking, and semantic entity mapping.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) structured for Google AI Overviews, Perplexity AI, ChatGPT Search, and Claude citations.
- Mysore and Karnataka regional local search optimization and high-authority backlink architecture.

### 5. UI/UX Design Systems (services/ui-ux-design.html)
- Design token architecture, modular UI components, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility compliance.
- Interactive user testing, journey mapping, and conversion funnel optimization.

### 6. Brand Strategy & 3D Spatial Graphics (services/brand-strategy.html)
- Three.js / WebGL hardware-accelerated 3D graphics, interactive canvas shaders, and ambient lighting.
- Typography systems, color theory, positioning narratives, and comprehensive brand guidelines.
